outcomeNote: continuation of the mishna's case list answering כיצד in the previous unit

segments.he: פָּשַׁט בַּעַל הַבַּיִת אֶת יָדוֹ לַחוּץ וְנָתַן לְתוֹךְ יָדוֹ שֶׁל עָנִי, אוֹ שֶׁנָּטַל מִתּוֹכָהּ וְהִכְנִיס — בַּעַל הַבַּיִת חַיָּיב וְהֶעָנִי פָּטוּר.
segments.en: The mishna cites two additional cases. In these, the prohibited labor is performed by the homeowner, who is in the private domain: «The homeowner» lifted an item in the private domain, «extended his hand into» the public domain, «and placed» the object «into the hand of the poor person.» In that case, the homeowner performed the labor of carrying out from the private domain into the public domain in its entirety. «Or,» the homeowner reached his hand into the public domain, «took» an object «from» the hand of the poor person, «and carried» it «into» the private domain. In that case, the homeowner performed the labor of carrying from the public domain into the private domain in its entirety. In both of those cases, because «the homeowner» performed the prohibited labor in its entirety, he «is liable and the poor person is exempt.»

moves.cueHe: פשט בעל הבית את ידו לחוץ
moves.summary: next two cases of the mishna's כיצד: the homeowner extends his hand out and gives to or takes from the poor person; homeowner liable, poor person exempt

positions.claim: where the homeowner alone performs the whole carrying out or carrying in, he is liable and the poor person exempt
